source_message.text:
There’s great news, Mara: Redwood Coilworks has reviewed your work and would like to arrange a meeting with you. The call would let them learn more about your background while giving you context about their company and brand. Please tell me whether you’re available during the first half of next week.

You can review the team’s feedback and suggested edits to your test article here: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MarinerNotes7315WillowReview/edit?usp=sharing>. Let me know if anything raises questions.

In addition to arranging the meeting, my team wants to give you another copywriting assignment. Rather than writing a blog article this time, you’ll update the copy on an existing landing page at <http://redwood-coilworks.example|redwood-coilworks.example>. I plan to send the brief three business days from now. Regarding your rates, how many hours do you expect this copy-editing project to require?

Thanks!

I’ll relay your available times and then send a Google Meets invitation. Which email address should I use for it?

Here is the specific existing landing page you’ll update: <https://redwood-coilworks.example/compression-springs>. As with the previous brief, we’ll include section-by-section instructions describing what we want to see.

Our current estimate is around 9 assignments per month, though that volume is not guaranteed. Because blogs are expected to require more time than copy-editing work, we may exchange 4 blogs for 8 copy-editing tasks as needed.
